tactics: intro α a l h <;> induction h with | head as => exact ⟨[], as, rfl⟩ | tail b _ ih => (obtain ⟨s, t, e⟩ := ih; exact ⟨b :: s, t, by simp [e]⟩)
intro α a l h <;> exact List.mem_iff_append.mp h
intro α a l h <;> induction l with | nil => simp at h | cons x xs ih => (rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with rfl | hm; exact ⟨[], xs, rfl⟩; obtain ⟨s, t, e⟩ := ih hm; exact ⟨x :: s, t, by simp [e]⟩)
